inputs.prompt:
Create one knee-up three-quarter character concept for a Korean Joseon dark-fantasy action RPG. One adult Korean woman: the revealed human form of the ordinary tavern hostess in the supplied reference. Use the reference for her exact recognizable face, eyes, expression, black hair and matte hand-painted art style. Keep focused almond-shaped amber eyes under slightly lowered eyelids, a slightly lowered chin, a small knowing asymmetric smile and the relaxed hand near her chin. She confidently meets the viewer's eyes, quietly inviting and predatory. Keep a plain wooden hairpin and loose black strands. One continuous composition, not the reference's split panels.

The costume must read as real Joseon garments that have come undone under their own weight. A faded-indigo cotton JEOGORI is still one complete garment: recognizable off-white collar, broad overlapping front panels, attached sleeves, real seams, a normal continuous hem and long loosened goreum ties. The outer ties have come undone and one shoulder has slipped out of the loosened neckline. The entire collar and front edge descend together in a coherent diagonal toward that shoulder. The opposite front panel remains draped over the chest with an opaque overlap. Show a broad exposed shoulder, collarbone and low neckline, with believable cloth tension at the surviving shoulder and hanging folds on the slipped side. Preserve broad cloth surfaces rather than converting the top into a narrow band. No detached breast band, no knotted crop top, no chest cutout, no random abdominal holes. Exposure follows the actual opened neckline and cloth overlap.

A dark-brown wrap CHIMA is held firmly by its real waistband. One outer skirt panel has been gathered and tucked into that same waistband at one hip, exposing one thigh. Show thick gathered folds and the visible weight of the hanging fabric; the opposite skirt panel remains long and heavy. The pale work apron survives at one side knot and hangs diagonally over the heavy skirt. Exposed thigh comes from the displaced garment panel, not an arbitrary slit punched into the skirt. All cloth has visible continuous edges, attachment points and believable gravity. The chest and hips remain covered by opaque cloth. The clothing feels dishevelled, decadent and physically worn, never a modern bikini, costume harness or ornate queen dress.

Keep her beautiful adult face human and composed. Long physical claws, blood beneath the fingernails, fresh blood on the fingers and wrist, smeared handprints on the apron, and heavy dark-red blood-soaked lower folds carry the brutality. Dark organic discoloration crosses the exposed neck and wrist. One hand rests near the chin as in the reference; the other hangs away from the body with natural separated fingers. Two normal human arms and legs, natural proportions and a grounded subtly forward-leaning invitation.

Nine substantial charcoal-black fox tails emerge behind the lower back and surround her asymmetrically in low trailing and raised rear arcs. Thick matte fur and physical mass; keep face, hands, shoulder and garment connections unobstructed. Dim wooden Korean tavern, cool shadows and restrained warm directional light. Matte painted skin, tactile cotton, fur and wood, large readable dark-fantasy shapes. Preserve the quiet mesmerizing face against blood-stained hands and heavy cloth. No glowing magic, purple aura, crown, insect armor, scorpion limbs, extra limbs, quadruped body, lettering or watermark.
